description: vertical-align: baseline, the initial value of a table cell, puts the first line of every cell in a row on one baseline however different their font sizes are; top and bottom are unaffected. Authored here rather than ported: the reference engine treats a cell's baseline as top, so there is no reference behaviour to port.
visual_assertions: In the first row the three words of different sizes sit on one baseline: the smaller text is pushed down, not aligned to the top of its cell.
In the second row Bigtop and Smalltop both start at the top of the row, so their baselines do not line up.
Smallbottom sits at the foot of its cell.
